_doc: Candid per-pose verdicts. Allowed: 'matches', 'roughly', 'does not', 'cannot judge'. A verdict of matches/roughly requires reviewed_image=true (the composite was opened and looked at). Every verdict is conditional on the ASSUMED pose in poses.json; none is a finding about the 1863 landscape alone.

verdicts.why: At the assumed Little Round Top summit pose the render has its horizon at 0.51 of the frame, the photograph's at about 0.40 (camera tilt/standpoint differ); the photograph's near-field is dominated by boulders and a tree that the DEM does not contain; the distant tree-clump ridge cannot be matched to mapped features because the DEM has no 1863 trees. Cannot be separated into terrain error vs pose error.

Camera placed 35 m south of the gazetteer gatehouse point looking north: the render shows no gatehouse (its footprint is hidden behind the modern DEM's rise or the camera is not where the photographer stood); the photograph shows the gatehouse filling the frame. The gatehouse footprint in the repository is a 2023-outline, tier inferred.

Standpoint on Seminary Ridge looking at the borough is contradicted by the photograph itself: a large cupola building and the town appear at distance with a road curving across the foreground, i.e. the camera stands further out; only 'from the West' is in the caption, no position. The render has the borough masses on the horizon only. Horizon 0.50 vs photo 0.38.

Same assumed pose as P04 although the two photographs have different standpoints (P05 has a brick house in the near middle ground). One pose cannot be right for both; the caption gives no position. Horizon 0.50 vs photo 0.38.
